title: docs: clarify ownership of jv arguments and results
body:
The ownership comment in `jv.h` currently says every `jv_*` function except `jv_copy` consumes its input. Several accessors and object-iteration functions borrow their arguments instead, which makes that guidance misleading for callers and language bindings.

Document the borrowing exceptions beside their declarations, including numeric helpers and `jv_show`. Clarify that returned `jv` values are owned, while the pointers returned by `jv_string_value` and `jv_number_get_literal` belong to their input values. This changes comments only.

Validated against the implementations in `src/jv.c` and `src/jv_print.c`. Built with bundled Oniguruma and ran `make check`: all 9 jq test scripts and all 14 Oniguruma tests passed. `git diff --check` also passed.

Fixes #3581.
